title: CleanEnchants
description: Aeshtetic attributes for items! made by Soakless
body:
CleanEnchant is a plugin for:
- enchants up to 255, 
- enchanting ANYTHING, 
- adding wearable player heads, 
- custom enchant names, 
- custom item names, 
- clean level numbers (get rid of ugly roman numbers and enchant.level.x!).
   
This is a VERY early version, please report any bugs on my discord: soaklesss

Commands:
- /ce help (help menu)
- /ce name <name> (changes the held item name, supports HEX)
- /ce enchant <enchantment> <level> <enchantmentColor> <levelColor> -gap <gap (default 0)> (enchants items, supports HEX for colors, you can have spaces in enchantment color but not in levelColor!)
